nodes.label: Mobile-First Responsive Principle
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Start with mobile styles, then layer responsive variants for larger breakpoints.

nodes.label: Design Skill
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Unified design skill consolidating brand, tokens, UI, logo, CIP, slides, banners, social photos and icons behind one entry point with sub-skill routing.

nodes.label: White Background Logo Rule
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Logos are always generated on white backgrounds so they remain clean and reusable for downstream CIP mockups.

nodes.label: Brand Sync Workflow
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Edit brand guidelines, sync to design tokens, then verify via context injection.

nodes.label: Banner Design Rules
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Safe zones, single CTA, max 2 fonts, <20% ad text because Meta penalizes text-heavy ads, print at 300 DPI CMYK with bleed.

nodes.label: AI Visual Generation (Gemini Flash / Pro)
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Flash model (2K) for fast backgrounds/patterns and A/B variants; Pro model (4K) for hero illustrations and photorealism. Prompts specify no-text because text is overlaid in HTML.

nodes.label: Multiple Art Direction Options
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Generates 2-3 complementary styles per request (default 3 options) so users choose rather than iterate from one.

nodes.label: Banner Output Path Convention
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: assets/banners/{campaign}/{style}-{width}x{height}.png, kebab-case, optional date prefix.

nodes.label: Banner PNG Export via chrome-devtools
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: HTML banners served locally and screenshotted at exact platform dimensions with auto-compression above 5MB.

nodes.label: Banner Design Rules
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Safe zones, single CTA, max 2 fonts, <20% text for ads because Meta penalizes heavy text, print at 300 DPI CMYK with bleed.

nodes.label: Banner Design Workflow
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Five steps: gather requirements, research art direction, design options, export PNGs, present and iterate.

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern Breaking
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Alternates "What Is" (frustration) and "What Could Be" (hope) with breaks at 1/3 and 2/3 for engagement.

nodes.label: Token Compliance Rule
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Never use raw hex in components; slides import design-tokens.css and use var() exclusively.

nodes.label: Form Validation with React Hook Form + Zod
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.norm_label: form validation with react hook form + zod

nodes.label: Three-Layer Token Structure
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Primitive -> Semantic -> Component; semantic layer enables theme switching, component layer enables per-component customization.

nodes.label: Accessibility-First Principle
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Leverage Radix UI primitives, add focus states, and use semantic HTML instead of re-implementing accessibility.

nodes.label: Copy-Paste Component Distribution Model
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Components live in your codebase rather than as a dependency, so they can be modified directly and composed freely.

nodes.label: Utility-First Styling
nodes.author: claudekit
nodes.rationale: Use Tailwind classes directly; extract components only for true repetition. Build-time processing gives zero runtime overhead and automatic dead-code elimination; avoid dynamic class names so purging works.

nodes.label: Base Color Presets (Slate, Gray, Zinc, Neutral, Stone)
nodes.norm_label: base color presets (slate, gray, zinc, neutral, stone)

nodes.label: shadcn CSS Variable System (globals.css :root/.dark)
nodes.rationale: CSS variables enable runtime theme switching between light and dark without rebuilding classes.

nodes.label: HSL Values Without hsl() Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Storing bare H S L channels allows opacity modifiers like hsl(var(--primary) / 0.5).

nodes.label: Semantic Color Naming
nodes.rationale: Use destructive not red, muted not gray, so themes can remap colors without changing component code.

nodes.label: Responsive Testing Checklist (320-1280px, 44x44 touch targets)
nodes.rationale: Limit to 2-3 breakpoints per element for maintainability and test at exact breakpoint boundaries to catch edge cases.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Semantic Overrides
nodes.rationale: Overriding only semantic tokens under .dark enables instant theme switching.

nodes.label: State Priority Order
nodes.rationale: disabled > loading > active > focus > hover > default.

nodes.label: SHA-Pinned Actions & Least-Privilege Permissions
nodes.rationale: Actions are pinned to commit SHAs, permissions limited to contents: read, and persist-credentials: false to reduce supply-chain and token-leak risk.

nodes.rationale: Checkbox and radio items do not close the menu on click; the app only uses regular items and links.

nodes.label: Extractable Brand Fields
nodes.rationale: colors, typography, voice and logo fields are structured so scripts can parse them.

nodes.label: Always Sync All Three Files
nodes.rationale: Never update brand-guidelines.md alone; tokens JSON and CSS must stay in sync.

nodes.label: Per-side translate transitions
nodes.rationale: Slide-in keyframes restated as translate transitions per side.

nodes.label: delay prop (formerly delayDuration)
nodes.rationale: skipDelayDuration and disableHoverableContent have no equivalent; provider delay stays 0.

nodes.label: Sheet on dialog primitive
nodes.rationale: Uses the same dialog primitive as the modal, with edge slide classes on data-starting-style / data-ending-style.

nodes.label: buttonVariants
nodes.rationale: Same variant and size classes kept so styling is unchanged.

nodes.label: @base-ui/react/avatar
nodes.rationale: Direct part rename.

nodes.label: @base-ui/react/button
nodes.rationale: Replaces Slot/asChild; the real Button primitive accepts render.

nodes.label: data-checked attribute
nodes.rationale: Replaces Radix data-[state=checked].

nodes.label: Collapsible Panel (formerly Content)
nodes.rationale: Public names Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger and CollapsibleContent kept.

nodes.label: new-york style (legacy)
nodes.rationale: No base-new-york counterpart exists, so classes were kept and style stays new-york so the look is not replaced by a Base UI preset.

nodes.label: @radix-ui/react-* packages
nodes.rationale: Every @radix-ui/react-* dependency was removed.

nodes.label: Base UI Tooltip
nodes.rationale: Portal, then Positioner, then Popup.

nodes.label: useRender hook
nodes.rationale: Polymorphic Badge uses Base UI's useRender instead of Radix Slot; no app call site used asChild on Badge.

nodes.label: Native label element
nodes.rationale: Base UI has no Label primitive, so the wrapper renders a native label; class string with peer-disabled hooks kept.

nodes.label: asChild to render prop
nodes.rationale: Base UI composes via a `render` prop instead of Radix `asChild`/Slot, so all call sites were rewritten.

nodes.label: data-starting-style / data-ending-style motion
nodes.rationale: Open/close motion uses Base UI's starting/ending style attributes instead of tailwind animate-in/animate-out.

nodes.label: Radix UI to Base UI Migration
nodes.norm_label: radix ui to base ui migration
nodes.rationale: Whole-project switch from Radix primitives to @base-ui/react; typechecks with only three pre-existing unrelated errors.

nodes.label: Transformation Engine
nodes.rationale: Automated codemod used on 2026-10-07 for every component migration, followed by a leftover scan.

nodes.label: Menu button composition via render
nodes.rationale: Sidebar menu buttons compose with the tooltip and dropdown trigger through render.

nodes.label: Dialog Backdrop and Popup
nodes.rationale: Overlay became Backdrop and Content became Popup; no Positioner because the dialog stays centered.

nodes.label: Opacity and scale transitions
nodes.rationale: Replace animate-in / animate-out for enter and exit.

nodes.label: CIP Workflow
nodes.rationale: Logo-based mockups are recommended (image editing); if no logo exists, generate one with Logo Design first.

nodes.label: Gemini Flash/Pro Image Models
nodes.rationale: flash (gemini-2.5-flash-image) is fast and cost-effective default; pro (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) chosen for quality and 4K text rendering.

nodes.label: CIP HTML Presentation
nodes.rationale: Images embedded as base64 so the presentation is a single portable file.

nodes.label: decorative prop dropped
nodes.rationale: No longer accepted; nothing in the app passed it.

nodes.label: data-pressed attribute
nodes.rationale: Replaces Radix data-[state=on].

nodes.label: @base-ui/react/toggle-group
nodes.rationale: Group root is Base UI toggle-group; items are Base UI toggle.

nodes.label: multiple boolean (replaces type)
nodes.rationale: type="single"|"multiple" is gone; value is always an array. No call site passed type.

nodes.label: Social Art Direction Styles (Reuse from Banner)
nodes.norm_label: social art direction styles (reuse from banner)

nodes.label: Screenshot Export (Chrome Headless / Playwright / Puppeteer)
nodes.rationale: Delay 3-5s after load so fonts/images render; deviceScaleFactor 2 for retina output.

nodes.label: Social Photos 8-Step Workflow
nodes.rationale: Randomly invoke ui-ux-pro-max or frontend-design each run for design variety; parallel subagents for independent HTML/export tasks.

nodes.label: Banner CTA Rules
nodes.rationale: One high-contrast CTA bottom-right (terminal area), min 44px height for mobile tap targets.

nodes.label: Banner Safe Zones
nodes.rationale: Keep critical content in central 70-80% to avoid platform UI chrome and cropping (e.g. YouTube 1546x423 safe area).

nodes.label: Text-to-Image Ratio
nodes.rationale: Ads kept under 20% text because Meta penalizes text-heavy ads.

nodes.label: Non-primitive wrappers (alert, card, input, skeleton, spinner)
nodes.norm_label: non-primitive wrappers (alert, card, input, skeleton, spinner)
nodes.rationale: Left alone along with sonner and input-otp because they have no Radix dependency.

nodes.label: render={<Link />}
nodes.rationale: Inertia Link passed via render instead of asChild.

nodes.label: Banner CTA Rules
nodes.rationale: One high-contrast CTA, bottom-right terminal area, min 44px for mobile tap targets.

nodes.label: Banner Safe Zones
nodes.rationale: Critical content in central 70-80% to avoid platform UI chrome and cropping.

nodes.label: Text-to-Image Ratio
nodes.rationale: Ads under 20% text because Meta penalizes text-heavy creatives.

nodes.label: 3-Zone Visual Hierarchy Rule
nodes.rationale: Top: logo/value prop, middle: supporting message, bottom: CTA.

nodes.label: Focus Management (focus trap, focus-visible rings)
nodes.rationale: Use focus-visible instead of removing outlines so keyboard users always see focus without showing rings on mouse clicks.

nodes.label: Brand Color Compliance Validation
nodes.rationale: Primary 60-70%, secondary 20-30%, accent 5-10%, max 20% off-palette colors.

nodes.label: data-popup-open on menu buttons
nodes.rationale: Replaces data-[state=open].

nodes.label: Voice vs. Tone
nodes.rationale: Voice is the consistent personality; tone adapts it to context.

nodes.label: Component Token Layer
nodes.rationale: Per-component customization.

nodes.label: Primitive Token Layer
nodes.rationale: Raw values; rarely changed.

nodes.label: Semantic Token Layer
nodes.rationale: Meaning assignment; changed for theme switching.

nodes.label: Token Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: --{category}-{item}-{variant}-{state}

nodes.label: HSL Opacity Modifiers
nodes.rationale: Space-separated HSL without hsl() lets Tailwind apply /50-style opacity modifiers.

nodes.label: Asset Directory Structure
nodes.rationale: Git-tracked .assets/ metadata separated from raw files in assets/.

nodes.label: Asset Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: {type}_{campaign}_{description}_{timestamp}_{variant}.{ext}; "evergreen" for non-campaign assets.

nodes.label: Archive, Don't Delete
nodes.rationale: Outdated assets moved to archived/ with date prefix to preserve history.

nodes.label: Logo Clear Space
nodes.rationale: Clear space equals the height of the logo mark.

nodes.label: Python 3.10+ Standard Library Only
nodes.rationale: Scripts have no third-party runtime dependencies; only pytest tooling is needed for development.

nodes.label: alignItemWithTrigger={false}
nodes.rationale: Replaces former position="popper".

nodes.label: Base UI Select
nodes.rationale: Viewport became List, scroll buttons became arrows, positioning moved to Positioner. No page currently renders a Select.

nodes.label: collisionAvoidance
nodes.rationale: Replaces avoidCollisions={false} with side, align and fallback set to none.

nodes.label: Layout Decision Flow
nodes.rationale: Slide goal → layout-logic.csv, emotion → color-logic.csv, content → typography.csv; break pattern with full-bleed at 1/3 and 2/3 positions.

nodes.label: Nancy Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternate 'What Is' vs 'What Could Be'; pattern breaks at 1/3 and 2/3 positions create engagement peaks.

nodes.label: Skill Dependency Chain (brand → design-system → ui-styling)
nodes.rationale: Brand supplies colors/typography to design-system, which supplies tokens/specs to ui-styling, which produces components for application code.

nodes.label: NavigationMenuIndicator
nodes.rationale: Renders Base UI's Icon part instead of an animated Radix indicator.

nodes.label: Base UI NavigationMenu
nodes.rationale: Root, list, item, trigger, content and link map directly; viewport is Portal, Positioner, Popup, then Viewport; indicator is Icon.

nodes.label: 50ms hover open delay
nodes.rationale: Follows Base UI default (Radix was 200ms); nothing in the app opens a nav popup.

nodes.label: viewport boolean wrapper prop
nodes.rationale: No longer a primitive prop; the wrapper still accepts it and skips the viewport when false.

nodes.label: 16:9 Slide Deck Base HTML Structure
nodes.rationale: Deck locked to 16:9 with letterboxing on desktop; .slide-content wrapper and overflow hidden prevent content overflow; responsive breakpoints at 768/480px.

nodes.label: tdams no logo.png
nodes.description: TDAMS wordmark only, without the seal/emblem row: 'PROVINCIAL ASESSOR'S OFFICE' heading, large outlined blue 'TDAMS' letters with drop shadow, and 'TAX DECLARATION ARCHIVE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM' tagline.

nodes.label: TDAMS-logo.png
nodes.description: Transparent-background TDAMS wordmark banner: Ilocos Norte provincial seal and Bagong Pilipinas emblem on top, 'PROVINCIAL ASESSOR'S OFFICE' heading, large outlined blue 'TDAMS' letters, and 'TAX DECLARATION ARCHIVE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM' tagline.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Canvas Design Process (Philosophy then Visual Expression)
nodes.norm_label: two-phase canvas design process (philosophy then visual expression)
nodes.rationale: A 4-6 paragraph design philosophy (manifesto) is written first and then expressed as a canvas artifact, so every visual decision is guided by a coherent aesthetic movement rather than templates.

nodes.label: Messaging Framework Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Mission -> Vision -> Value Proposition -> Positioning -> Key Messages -> Proof Points.

nodes.label: Refinement Process (polish, don't expand)
nodes.rationale: The critical second pass refines existing elements instead of adding graphics, respecting the minimalism philosophy.

nodes.label: Visual Communication First (90% visual / 10% text)
nodes.rationale: Information lives in design, not paragraphs; text is a rare, powerful gesture integrated into the visual architecture.

nodes.label: Intentional OKLCH Color Palette (2-5 colors)
nodes.rationale: oklch color space chosen for precision; limited palette so each shade carries meaning.

nodes.label: @theme Directive (CSS-based design tokens)
nodes.rationale: Preferred modern approach for simple customizations; tokens defined in CSS become utilities.

nodes.label: @apply Directive
nodes.rationale: Use @apply only for truly repeated patterns; extract components sparingly.

nodes.label: Content Configuration & Safelist
nodes.rationale: Safelist preserves dynamically-built class names that the content scanner cannot detect.
